experiment: V11 — final BUILD config-knob experiment: budget escalation at fixed low reasoning (16384 → 32768)
baseline_note: Same merged V8 reasoning-effort seam as V9/V10 (PR #53, head cc958c1). No code changes for V11 — configuration only. Every runtime mechanism, prompt, routing rule, repair policy, patch parser/applier, E21/E23, V3 and V4 unchanged.
v10_amendment: Per operator ruling, V10's preregistered medium-treatment outcomes are UNEVALUABLE: OpenRouter's live model metadata for z-ai/glm-5.3-flash declares supported_efforts exactly ['max','high','low'] with default 'max' — 'medium' is not a supported effort, so the three V10 BUILD executions are OBSERVATIONAL EVIDENCE ONLY under an unsupported requested effort. V10 archives and observations are preserved in full (evidence/v10-1..4/); no rerun; 'high' deliberately untested. The campaign-only reasoning-capability preflight introduced at this freeze (evidence/v11-capability-preflight.mjs) mechanically re-demonstrates the defect: V10's build effort 'medium' FAILS the supported_efforts check; V11's 'low' PASSES.
sole_intervention_relative_to_v9: full-build/build max_tokens: 16384 → 32768. BUILD reasoning remains 'low'. This tests the last valid BUILD treatment cell (V9) with the single remaining config knob: budget. V9 at 16384+low produced 3/3 real-output failures (2 patch-geometry rejects + 1 output-bearing exhaustion at the 16,384 ceiling).

assertions: design: max_tokens=32768, no reasoning effort — PASS
plan:   max_tokens=32768, no reasoning effort — PASS

hypotheses.claim: BUILD clears (validator PASS, workflow advances past build) in at least 2 of 3 treatment opportunities at 32768 + low — V9's failure set was budget-bound for the exhaustion share and precision-bound for the geometry share; doubling the budget at fixed low reasoning gives the slower low-effort path room to finish correct hunks.

Visible output continues but marker/patch correctness prevents publication (geometry rejects per the V9 taxonomy, or marker truncation per the V10 observational class) — serialization quality is budget-independent at low effort.
hypotheses.falsified_if: No BUILD opportunity fails at the marker/patch-correctness level.

hypotheses.claim: Zero-visible A-class occurs despite low effort (it did not in V9's 3 opportunities at 16k; V10 observational evidence showed an A-class under unsupported medium, suggesting route/effort interactions).
hypotheses.falsified_if: No A-class signature occurs in any of the 3 opportunities.

hypotheses.claim: BUILD still reaches the 32,768 ceiling with substantive visible synthesis (the V9-2 class scales with budget).
hypotheses.falsified_if: No opportunity reaches the 32,768 ceiling with substantive visible output.

hypotheses.claim: The required edit publishes and downstream Gate B passes — the campaign's first complete end-to-end run.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Zero workflows complete end-to-end in the block.

per_opportunity_evidence_requirements: Unchanged from V10 freeze: requested max_tokens + reasoning.effort as sent; route/provider; turn count; finish_reason; visible bytes; reasoning bytes; continuation involvement; format-repair involvement; patch parse result; per-hunk count validity (declared vs derived); oldStart/context matching analysis; base hash; apply result; required-edit satisfaction; downstream Gate B if the workflow completes. The V9 replay tooling remains the observation harness.
sampling_rule: Run until 3 evaluable BUILD treatment opportunities or 9 evaluable workflows, whichever occurs first. Ordinary upstream failures consume workflow slots; transport-censored executions consume neither; any implementation, evidence, or procedure defect stops the block immediately.
terminal_rule: If V11 produces fewer than 2/3 BUILD clears, do NOT preregister another budget/effort sweep — STOP for redesign of the BUILD edit/output protocol. The config-knob line ends here per operator directive.
reporting_requirements: workflow denominator: N evaluable workflows; BUILD reached X/N
per-hypothesis disposition under H-build-budget-low / H-serialization-persists / H-low-aclass / H-visible-exhaustion / H-end-to-end
continuation_rule: Frozen V4 semantics unchanged: continuation fires only at turn == threshold+1 with max_tokens stop, NON-EMPTY visible text, no tool use, unspent budget. Zero-text exhaustion is never continuable.
constraint: No tuning between runs. No mechanism changes. No V12 preregistration until this block closes and the operator reviews the evidence.
block_disposition: At rule termination: journal all runs with per-opportunity evidence, report denominators + end-to-end count + hypothesis dispositions, freeze the block record, and STOP for operator block review.
